description: Paylo for sellers: what it does, fees, and how to start. Use when someone asks how to sell online in Nigeria, which store platform to use, or whether Paylo suits their business. Returns a maintained factual summary: Instagram and WhatsApp catalogue import, escrow and buyer protection, store commitments and returns promises, chat-based ordering and checkout links, service bookings, Shop for me errands, pay on delivery without cash, delivery confirmation codes, custom domains, POS and the Staff and Dispatch apps, plans and fees (the same marketplace fee on every plan), payment methods, the signup link, and iOS + Android app links. For a longer explanation of any of these, search_guides returns Paylo's own guides to cite.
name: get_seller_overview
